content:
The **Austin Public Library** in **Austin, Minnesota**, is a branch of the **Mower County Library System** and serves the residents of Austin and the surrounding area. Here’s everything I could find about it:

---

### **📍 Location & Basic Info**
- **Address:**
  323 4th Ave NE, Austin, MN 55912
- **Phone:** (507) 433-2377
- **Website:** [Mower County Library System – Austin Branch](https://www.mowercounty.lib.mn.us/)
- **Hours:**
  - **Monday–Thursday:** 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM
  - **Friday:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
  - **Saturday:** 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
  - **Sunday:** Closed
  *(Hours may vary; check the official website for updates.)*

---

### **🏛️ History**
- The **Austin Public Library** has been serving the community for over a century.
- The current building was constructed in **1969** and has undergone renovations to modernize facilities.
- It is part of the **Southeastern Libraries Cooperating (SELCO)** system, which allows patrons to access materials from multiple libraries in the region.

---

### **📚 Services & Resources**
#### **For Patrons:**
- **Book Checkouts:** Physical books, e-books, audiobooks, large-print books, and more.
- **Digital Library:**
  - **OverDrive/Libby** (e-books & audiobooks)
  - **Hoopla** (streaming movies, music, comics)
  - **TumbleBooks** (children’s e-books)
  - **Ancestry.com** (in-library use only)
  - **Mango Languages** (language learning)
- **Internet & Computer Access:** Free Wi-Fi and public computers with printing services.
- **Printing, Copying, & Faxing:** Available for a small fee.
- **Meeting Rooms:** Reservable spaces for community groups and events.
- **Interlibrary Loan:** Request materials from other libraries in the SELCO system.

#### **For Kids & Teens:**
- **Storytime & Early Literacy Programs** (e.g., Baby & Me, Preschool Storytime)
- **Summer Reading Program** (with prizes and activities)
- **Teen Book Clubs & Activities**
- **LEGO Clubs, Crafts, and STEM Programs**

#### **For Adults:**
- **Book Clubs** (e.g., the **Austin Reads** program)
- **Author Visits & Workshops**
- **Job & Career Resources** (resume help, online job search tools)
- **Local History & Genealogy** (access to historical records, newspapers, and Austin-area archives)

---

### **🎉 Events & Programs**
The library hosts a variety of **free public events**, including:
- **Author Talks & Book Signings**
- **Craft & DIY Workshops**
- **Tech Help Sessions** (for seniors or those new to computers)
- **Movie Screenings**
- **Community Discussions & Lectures**
- **Seasonal Events** (e.g., Holiday markets, Halloween parties)

*(Check the [Mower County Library Events Calendar](https://www.mowercounty.lib.mn.us/events) for updates.)*

---

### **📖 Special Collections & Local Interest**
- **Austin & Mower County History:** The library has a **local history collection**, including:
  - Historical photos of Austin
  - Old newspapers (microfilm & digital)
  - Books on Minnesota and Mower County history
  - Genealogy resources
- **Hormel Historical Collection:** Since Austin is the home of **Hormel Foods**, the library may have materials related to the company’s history and its impact on the town.

---

### **🚗 Accessibility & Amenities**
- **Handicap Accessible:** The building has ramps, elevators, and accessible restrooms.
- **Parking:** Free parking is available near the library.
- **Bike Racks:** Available for cyclists.
- **Language Access:** Some materials in Spanish and other languages may be available.

---

### **💡 Unique Features**
- **Seed Library:** Patrons can "check out" seeds for gardening (seasonal).
- **Library of Things:** Some locations in the SELCO system offer non-traditional items like **tools, kitchen gadgets, or board games**—check if Austin participates.
- **3D Printing:** Some SELCO libraries offer 3D printing services (confirm availability in Austin).

---

### **📝 How to Get a Library Card**
- **Residents of Mower County:** Free library card (with proof of address).
- **Non-Residents:** May obtain a card for a small annual fee.
- **Reciprocal Borrowing:** If you have a card from another SELCO library, you can use it in Austin.

*(Apply in person or online via the [Mower County Library website](https://www.mowercounty.lib.mn.us/).)*

---

### **📞 Contact & Social Media**
- **Email:** austin@selco.info
- **Facebook:** [Mower County Library – Austin](https://www.facebook.com/mowercountylibrary/)
- **SELCO Website:** [www.selco.info](https://www.selco.info)

---

### **🏙️ About Austin, MN**
For context, Austin (nicknamed **"Spamtown USA"**) is known for:
- **Hormel Foods** (SPAM Museum is a major attraction)
- **Historic Downtown** (with murals and local shops)
- **Jay C. Hormel Nature Center** (a great outdoor spot)
- **Strong Scandinavian & Immigrant Heritage**

The library plays a key role in preserving and sharing the city’s history.

---
### **❓ Frequently Asked Questions**
**Q: Can I return books from other SELCO libraries to Austin Public Library?**
A: Yes! The library participates in **SELCO’s shared system**, so you can return materials from any SELCO library to Austin.

**Q: Does the library offer notary services?**
A: Some libraries do, but it’s best to **call ahead** to confirm if Austin provides this service.

**Q: Is there a friends of the library group?**
A: Yes! The **Friends of the Austin Public Library** supports the library through fundraising, book sales, and advocacy.

**Q: Can I donate books to the library?**
A: Yes, but **call first**—they often accept donations for their **book sale** or collection, but space may be limited.

---
### **🔍 Additional Resources**
- **SELCO Catalog:** [https://selco.ent.sirsi.net](https://selco.ent.sirsi.net) (Search for books, place holds)
- **Minnesota Digital Library:** [https://mndigital.org](https://mndigital.org) (Historical photos & documents)
- **Spam Museum:** [https://www.spam.com/museum](https://www.spam.com/museum) (If you're visiting Austin!)

---
